title: Hearty Roast Mediterranean Roast
description: A flavorful, festive, and nutritious dish featuring a crispy roasted leg of lamb with a side of petit pois and cherry tomatoes.
instructions: Season the leg of lamb with salt, black pepper, and rosemary.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the leg of lamb on all sides until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast the lamb for 20 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the oven and add the cherry tomatoes, petit pois, garlic, salt, and black pepper to the skillet.
Return the skillet to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 25-30 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Remove the skillet from the oven and squeeze the lemon juice over the lamb and vegetables.
Let the lamb rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
